$comment: requires_bootstrap 0.160.0 is the first bootstrap that revokes undeclared bootstrap-written .pth links and holds a plugin venv at the highest released version of a first-party package its pyproject requires (the released-target venv stamp), so the venv's llm_kit is the katsoft-llm-kit wheel and never a stale link. It also covers every *_BOOTSTRAP floor the library names (the library binds bootstrap_lib call shapes first shipped no later than bootstrap 0.154.1). The plugin publishes no shared lib: llm_kit reaches every consumer as the katsoft-llm-kit package, and bootstrap revokes the standalone interpreter's llm_kit link it wrote earlier. No config block: llm-kit seeds no user config and reads the legacy credential and config locations unchanged. The one custom script, custom_bootstrap.py, only checks the OpenRouter credential (it runs `llm-kit account status --json` under the plugin venv, reads the credential locations through it, never writes them) and records an unmet or rejected key as a deferred requirement in this plugin's own data directory; it migrates no legacy .env or data directory and seeds no layer. The venv carries the extras named in pyproject.toml's katsoft-llm-kit requirement and the llm-kit console script that distribution installs; the standalone interpreter carries no llm_kit. The git tool is declared because the jobs group creates and reclaims per-attempt git worktrees.
